    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    a = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
    b = [0] * n
    b[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n):
        if a[i] > a[i-1]:
            b[i] = min([x for x in range(1, 6) if x > b[i-1]])
        elif a[i] < a[i-1]:
            b[i] = max([x for x in range(1, 6) if x < b[i-1]])
        else:
            b[i] = [x for x in range(1, 6) if x != b[i-1]][0]
        if b[i] == 0:
            print(-1)
            return
    print(' '.join(map(str, b)))
